title: Web UI header + mobile fixes
description:
Fix 6 bug Web UI segnalati dall'utente, tutti nel frontend @agent-plan/web-ui, testabili su mobile (390px) e desktop.

1. LOCATE sotto header (mobile/bassa altezza): packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx — l'effect locate usa el.scrollIntoView({block:"center"}) che non contabilizza l'header sticky (TopNav + ActiveTasksHeader, fino a 35vh) né la .ap-search-sticky bar (top: headerH). Su viewport basso/mobile il task row finisce dietro gli elementi sticky. Fix: scroll manuale window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY - headerH - stickyBarH - 12 }) usando gli offset già misurati (headerH) + misura .ap-search-sticky.

2. LINK HANDOFF in header: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — navItems ha solo Dashboard + Features. Aggiungere NavLink a /handoff (route esistente packages/plan-web-ui/src/app/router.tsx:65) con icona ScrollText (lucide).

3. EXPORT dropdown mobile non visibile: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — il dropdown (absolute right-0 z-50 mt-2) apre sotto il bottone; su mobile (flex-col) finisce nella zona ActiveTasksHeader. Fix: z-index robusto + su mobile aprire verso l'alto (bottom-full mb-2) o portare fuori dallo stacking. Verificare con puppeteer.

4. BOTTONI header mobile troppo grandi: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — LiveStatusBadge, NavLink, Export, theme button usano min-h-11 (44px). Ridurre a min-h-9 mobile, sm:min-h-11 desktop.

5. RESET non pulisce elastic input: packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts resetFilters() (riga ~330) resetta hideDone/hidePlanned/onlyActiveBranches/statusFilters/treeOpenMode/showAllFeatures ma NON searchQuery. Fix: aggiungere setSearchQuery("").

6. HIDE Planned/Done ignorati quando l'elastic input ha testo: packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts displayedWorkTree useMemo — il branch `if (searchActive)` (riga ~283) filtra SOLO per matchedTaskIds, non applica effectiveTaskStatusFilters (che incorporano hideDone/hidePlanned). Fix: nel branch search, filtrare i task matched anche per matchesStatus(task.status, effectiveTaskStatusFilters) e feature/phase per i rispettivi effective filters.

Comportamenti da preservare: locate pulse (locatePulseId ap-search-hit), persistenza localStorage dei filtri, espansione smart-mode.

tasks.title: Hide Planned/Done apply during elastic search
tasks.description: packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts — displayedWorkTree useMemo branch `if (searchActive)` filtrava SOLO per matchedTaskIds, bypassando effectiveTaskStatusFilters (che incorporano hideDone/hidePlanned). Comportamento preservato: espansione smart-mode in search, persistenza localStorage. Shippato in 0.2.19-next.9.

tasks.title: Refine Edit project button vertical alignment with Project Goal heading
tasks.description:
User reports the 'Edit project' button on the dashboard Project Goal card is still visually misaligned after the previous fix. The current layout wraps the button in the same flex container as the entire content block (title + description), causing the button to align to the top of the block rather than to the heading baseline.

A better layout is to place only the 'Project Goal' h2 and the button on the same flex line, so the button can be baseline-aligned with just the heading. The description then sits below.

Code references:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx

Acceptance:
- The Edit project button is visually aligned with the Project Goal heading.
- The description text sits below and wraps normally.
- Layout works on both desktop and mobile.
- Build and copy bundle pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Refined Edit project button alignment in packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx. Instead of placing the button in the same flex container as the entire content block (title + description), the heading 'Project Goal' and the button now share their own flex row with items-baseline, so the button text baseline aligns with the heading baseline. The description sits below. This should resolve the perceived misalignment caused by the button content being padded/centered within a larger box aligned to the top of the content block. Build and bundle copy pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Second attempt at fixing Edit project button alignment. Changed the heading/button row from items-baseline to items-center in packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx. This vertically centers the 'Project Goal' heading with the button, which is typically the expected visual alignment for a heading + action button pair. Built and copied bundle.

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixed internal button content alignment in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/button.tsx. The inner <span> wrapping children (icon + text) now uses inline-flex items-center, so icons and labels are vertically centered relative to each other. This fixes the visual misalignment of the Edit project button specifically and improves all buttons with icons. Built and copied bundle.

tasks.title: Uniform filter buttons and convert expand/collapse to single toggle
tasks.description:
User requests improvements to the Work Tree filter/controls bar:
1. The 5 buttons under the filters (Hide done, Hide planned, Only active, Reset, Repair) look inconsistent — last 2 have different borders. Make them smaller and uniform in style.
2. Replace the Expand all + Collapse all pair above the filters with a single toggle button.

Code references:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx (controls and filter buttons)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts (expandAll, setTreeOpenMode)

Acceptance:
- All 5 filter/action buttons share the same base style (size, border, padding) with only color/state differences to indicate active/inactive.
- Expand/collapse controls become one button that toggles between Expand all and Collapse all.
- Layout remains responsive.
- Build and copy bundle pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Reworked Work Tree controls in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx.

1. Added local ToolbarButton component: uniform h-8 min-h-8, rounded-[10px], px-2.5 py-1, text-xs, full-width grid cell. Active state uses solid accent background; inactive state uses surface-card background with border.

2. Replaced the 5 inconsistent filter/action buttons (Hide done, Hide planned, Only active, Reset, Repair) with ToolbarButton instances, all sharing the same base style. The active toggles now show accent fill instead of status-specific classes.

3. Replaced Expand all + Collapse all pair with a single toggle ToolbarButton that shows 'Expand all' / 'Collapse all' based on tree.treeOpenMode === 'all'. Clicking toggles between tree.expandAll() and tree.setTreeOpenMode('none').

Build and copy-web-ui.sh pass. Browser reload required.

---
**Completion summary:**
Moved Expand/Collapse button into the same filter toolbar row in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx. The Work Tree header no longer has a separate controls area; all 6 actions (Expand all / Collapse all, Hide done, Hide planned, Only active, Reset, Repair) are now in a single 6-column grid (lg:grid-cols-6). Removed the previous separate top-right button block. Build and bundle copy pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixed two issues:

1. Expand all toggle now works both ways. Previously the button compared tree.treeOpenMode === 'all', but expandAll() set mode to 'smart', so the label never switched. Added collapseAll() and isAllExpanded (derived from actual expandedFeatureIds/expandedPhaseIds vs displayedWorkTree) to useDashboardTree. The toolbar button now toggles expandAll/collapseAll and correctly shows 'Collapse all' when everything is expanded.

2. Matched detail page accordion border radius to Work Tree. Changed packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/accordion.tsx from rounded-lg to rounded-[10px], matching the Work Tree rows.

Build and bundle copy pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Verified the accordion border-radius change is present in both packages/plan-web-ui/dist and packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist bundles. The generated CSS shows rounded-[10px]{border-radius:10px} and the Accordion component no longer uses rounded-lg. User may be seeing a cached build; recommended hard refresh. No further code change needed unless cache busting is required.

tasks.title: Uniform detail page header identifiers with Work Tree EntityPathBadge
tasks.description:
User requests detail pages (feature, phase, task) show entity identifiers the same way as the Work Tree:
- show shortId
- show entity number/path (F00x/P00x/T00x)
- copyable badge
- clicking a segment navigates to that entity's detail page

Current detail pages use separate CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge + DisplayStatusBadge. Work Tree uses EntityPathBadge which shows colored segments and is copyable/clickable.

Code references:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/badges.tsx (EntityPathBadge, CopyableBadge, ShortIdBadge)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/feature-detail/route.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx

Acceptance:
- Feature detail header shows F00x segment (clickable to feature itself), shortId badge, status badge.
- Phase detail header shows F00x (clickable to feature) + P00x (clickable to phase itself), shortId badge, status badge.
- Task detail header shows F00x (clickable to feature) + P00x (clickable to phase) + T00x (clickable to task itself), shortId badge, status badge.
- EntityPathBadge supports copy on click (existing behavior) and segment links.
- Responsive and builds cleanly.

---
**Completion summary:**
Created a reusable DetailEntityBar component (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/detail/detail-entity-bar.tsx) that renders EntityPathBadge + CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge in the same order as the Work Tree, plus a trailing children slot for status/handoff badges.

Updated all three detail routes to use it:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/feature-detail/route.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx

This makes the detail page headers uniform with the Work Tree: colored F/P/T segments are clickable (navigate to the entity), the full path is copyable, and the shortId is shown.

Build and bundle copy pass. Hard refresh needed.

---
**Completion summary:**
Realized the actual mismatch was in the list rows (not just headers). Detail pages were using old EntityBadge/ParentBadge pills, while Work Tree uses EntityPathBadge. Updated both headers AND list rows:

Headers:
- Created DetailEntityBar component and used it in feature-detail, phase-detail, task-detail routes.
- Shows EntityPathBadge (clickable F/P/T segments) + CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge + status/handoff badges.

List rows (the real difference):
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/features/feature-row.tsx: replaced EntityBadge with EntityPathBadge + CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge.
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/phases/phase-row.tsx: replaced EntityBadge + ParentBadge with EntityPathBadge + CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge.
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/tasks/task-row.tsx: replaced EntityBadge with EntityPathBadge + CopyableBadge + ShortIdBadge; added featureNum/phaseNum props.
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx: passes featureNum/phaseNum to TaskRow.

Now detail page lists and headers use the same segmented, copyable, clickable entity identifiers as the Work Tree.

Build, type-check (pnpm check), and bundle copy all pass. Hard refresh required.

tasks.title: Add border radius to StatusItem surfaces
tasks.description:
User reports that status-item status-item--surface (the colored wrapper used in Work Tree rows) lacks border radius. Need to add border-radius to the .status-item class in base.css so the colored status rows/accordions in the Work Tree have rounded corners consistent with other cards/rows.

- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-item.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles/base.css

Acceptance:
- .status-item has border-radius (likely 10px to match Work Tree rows).
- Header and surface variants both rounded consistently.
- Build and copy bundle pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added .status-item border-radius rules to packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles/base.css:
- .status-item default border-radius: 10px
- .status-item--header: 10px 10px 0 0 (rounded top corners only, sits inside an accordion)
- .status-item--surface: 10px (full rounded corners for standalone rows like Work Tree task rows)

Build and bundle copy pass. Hard refresh needed.

**Completion summary:**
Fixed regression: removed the .status-item--header rule that was forcing flat bottom corners (border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0). Reverted to a single .status-item { border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } so all StatusItem variants keep rounded corners. This restores the bottom border radius of Work Tree feature/phase/task rows while still giving rounded corners to status surfaces. Build and bundle copy pass. Hard refresh needed.

tasks.title: Stack badge cluster above title in list rows

Current PhaseRow and TaskRow use a flex container that becomes row on desktop, placing the title beside the badges. We need to keep the column layout at all breakpoints so the title always sits below the badge cluster. FeatureRow should be aligned as well for consistency across all list rows.

Files to modify:

- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/phases/phase-row.tsx
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/tasks/task-row.tsx
